theme: Safety First at School & The Force of Friction

grammar_pattern.name: Past Continuous vs Past Simple with While / When
grammar_pattern.rule: was/were + V-ing for background action, Past Simple for interrupting action
examples: Jake **was walking** carefully when Tom **slipped** on the wet floor.
The cleaner **was drying** the tiles while the students **were waiting** outside.
Tom **was running** fast, so he did not see the yellow warning sign.

clil_topic.title: The Science of Friction & Floor Safety
clil_topic.focus: Friction force between shoes and floors, water greatly reducing surface friction
